atlas.name: Whisperwake Isles
atlas.blurb: The water archipelago north-west of the mainland, home to the late-game water Aniimo. Crescent Bay anchors the chain, with Reefish and Coraliz surfacing in the rain and Glameep only under an aurora.
labels: Lumin Marking: Above the White Cliffs
descriptions: Vein energy emerges here. Pathfinders can use Blooms for fast travel.

Mysterious chests are scattered across Idyll. They may be luggage lost by travelers, supplies left behind by Pathfinders, or treasures sealed away by an ancient civilization... All await discovery and opening.

Mysterious chests are scattered across Idyll. They may be luggage lost by travelers, supplies left behind by Pathfinders, or treasures sealed away by an ancient civilization... All of them are waiting to be discovered and opened.
Amber infused with Lumin Power. Branches can absorb its energy to grow.
The pines whisper softly, flowers dance in the breeze.
Nurtured by the Branches, large numbers of Aniimo gather here.
Prismana energy has gathered here, attracting a Prismana Aniimo.
Look up into the sky, and its shape will appear.
Only at low tide will its full form be revealed.

entity.name: Reefish
entity.description: They burrow underground to camouflage as coral and bite any prey that comes near. However, they sometimes get impatient and peek around.

entity.name: Bubbeep
entity.description: It stretches its leafy feathers with lazy ease, always chewing away as it turns algae and slime into floating bubbles. One light hop, and off it drifts, riding the bubbles like a little boat in the breeze.

entity.name: Popapus
entity.description: It loves collecting colorful bubbles. They bob and sway inside its air sac as it moves, and when inspiration strikes, it uses them to doodle strange little wonders in the air.

entity.name: Cheekie
entity.description: People often mistake the circles on their cheeks for eyes. They love to gather in groups on the shore, feeling safe only when they huddle closely with their companions.

entity.name: Malangel
entity.description: They disguise themselves with a cheerful smile to sneak up on targets. Once in combat, they reveal their true colors and bare their fangs poised to strike.

entity.name: Shelly
entity.description: Conceals itself among beach shells using its soft appendages to hold shells in place. Remains sealed during daylight.

entity.name: Gachapus
entity.description: With a quick tap from its nimble tentacles, it can launch all kinds of capsule bubbles from its head. No one knows what will pop out next, a delightful surprise, or a complete accident.

entity.name: Wavwal
entity.description: They move clumsily on land using their four limbs, but they are experts at sliding on their bellies. The males are highly territorial against other males, once angered, they unleash their wrath like a tsunami.

entity.name: Coraliz
entity.description: They love to bury themselves in sand, mimicking coral clumps. They use the glow of the coral on their head and back to lure creatures for a surprise attack.

entity.name: Malevsera
entity.description: They hide their fangs and claws in their soft body. Expert at using their gentle, harmless look to lower other creatures' guard before casually freezing them into ice sculptures.

entity.name: Glameep
entity.description: Draped in fresh green leaf-feathers, Glameep moves lightly along the lake shore. It adores clear water most of all, especially when that water reflects its own graceful, unhurried beauty.

entity.name: Lumin Amber
entity.description: These highly pure energy ambers originated from the overflowing Vein energy and have been refined over the ages. The power they contain is so intense that it can illuminate the surroundings, which earned it the name Lumin.

entity.name: Aniipod Pro
entity.description: The first upgraded product in the Aniipod series, designed to help Pathfinders catch Aniimo with greater ease.

entity.name: Aniipod
entity.description: A device for catching, equipping, and training aniimo. Polaris Institute researchers developed it using Lumintech after drawing inspiration from Ancient Idyll Civilization ruins.

entity.name: Coral Branch
entity.description: Fresh branches naturally shed from coral clusters. Their vivid offshoots contain the natural pigments favored by Popapus. Reefish are captivated by the satisfying crunch when biting into them and often use the branches to file down their teeth.

entity.name: Elite Egg
entity.description: An Egg with powerful vitality. Guaranteed to hatch an Aniimo with Elite potential or higher.

entity.name: Alpha Egg
entity.description: An Egg with unusual size and powerful energy fluctuations. Guaranteed to hatch an Aniimo with the Alpha trait.

regions.name: Crescent Bay
regions.desc: Giant bubbles drift like a crystal-clear dream, gently cradling the lone tree at the heart of the lake. Across the crescent-shaped bay, sky and clouds shimmer on the water, while Bubbeep blow light little bubbles and ride them lazily through their play.
